conversion: Only public numeric test values and the published padding-regression input were transcribed into JSON; no implementation code was imported. Hex case/whitespace normalized; source arrays otherwise unchanged.
client_private_note: The public client exponent is in the original vector cited by Apple at line165; Apple itself stores A but omits a.

padding_contract.scrambling_u: SHA512 of fixed-width A || fixed-width B
padding_contract.session_key: SHA512 of S after removing leading zero bytes
padding_contract.client_proof: A and B omit leading zero bytes in the M1 hash; salt remains its full 16 bytes
padding_contract.server_proof: M2 hashes the full 384-byte A, followed by the 64-byte M1 and K

evidence_limit: Crypto known answers and encoding reference only; not an AirPlay transient wire trace, independent wire interoperability or physical iPhone acceptance.

derived_vectors.status: Project-generated public test-only vectors; not published Apple known answers.
derived_vectors.method: Same RFC5054 modulus, generator, salt, username and password as the published vector. Leading-zero A uses a=1 and original b. Leading-zero B searches b0+i with original a. Leading-zero S searches a0+i with original b. First match within i=1..4096; HAP encoding follows the pinned Apple implementation. Both client and server Python pow/hashlib formulas must agree, and all original Apple fields are checked first.
derived_vectors.expected_padding_verifier: Expected bytes derived separately for the exact upstream little-endian test_bn_pad input.
